TEMPEST is set to become the Big News that will shake up the K-POP scene. TEMPEST is a seven-member boy group launched by Yuehua Entertainment for the first time in seven years. With the bright yet powerful energy of all seven members, the group sets its sights on dominating the K-POP market. Their dynamic performances and genre-spanning music reflect the confidence built through years of preparation and training. The group consists of LEW and Hyeongseop, previously active as the project unit “Hyeongseop X Euiwoong”; Hanbin and Hwarang, who gained recognition through competition programs; and Hyuk, Eunchan, and Taerae, who are being introduced to the public for the first time. Upon opening their official YouTube channel, TEMPEST surpassed 100,000 subscribers almost immediately, while their K-POP cover videos exceeded 1.2 million views within just two weeks of release—demonstrating remarkable momentum and impact. Widely recognized as one of the most anticipated rookie groups of 2022, TEMPEST is ready to unleash the boundless potential and individuality of its seven members through It’s ME, It’s WE. TEMPEST’s debut mini album It’s ME, It’s WE showcases a wide range of genres, combining powerful intensity with refreshing, youthful charm. Every track—beyond just the title song—has been crafted with care, offering strong replay and collectible value. The album highlights the group’s solid musical foundation: main vocalist Hyuk’s powerful yet refreshing voice, supported by lead vocalist Hanbin and sub-vocalists Hyeongseop and Eunchan; main rapper Hwarang’s rhythmic flow, joined by lead rapper LEW and sub-rapper Taerae, elevates the overall quality of every track. With this musical depth and versatility, TEMPEST is poised to earn the title of a group you can trust and enjoy listening to. Through promotions for the title track “Bad News,” TEMPEST is expected to become both the Big News and Good News of the K-POP industry. Despite its title, “Bad News” ironically delivers TEMPEST’s bold ambition and declaration to take over K-POP. The seamless interplay between rap and vocals, paired with funky rhythms, amplifies the group’s bright and energetic identity. En 1872, il s’installe à Auvers-sur-Oise où il peint avec Camille Pissarro et participe à l’exposition fondatrice du groupe impressionniste à Paris en 1874. Cezanne se partage entre Paris et la Provence. Il abandonne l’impressionnisme mais reste fidèle au travail en plein air et aux ombres colorées. Vers 1890-1895, sa peinture se renouvelle par un changement radical de style et de facture, dessinant fortement les contours des objets, esquissant seulement les modelés. En 1895, sa première exposition chez le marchand Ambroise Vollard le révèle au public. Les jeunes peintres le révèrent alors comme le précurseur de la peinture moderne par son sens du volume et l’importance donnée à la structure

rvation Scholarships Home · The Card Players The Card Players Paul Cézanne Cézanne became interested in depicting labourers playing cards in the autumn of 1890. During the 1890s he completed five paintings of this subject. Here, the composition is refined down to two men seated across a table in undefined surroundings. The players face each other but are immersed in the ritual of the game. Farm workers from the estate of Cézanne’s father posed for the two figures. They are the human equivalents of the painter’s views of Mount Saint Victoire: timeless, monumental and resolutely Provençal. highlights: Năm 1874, Cézanne tham gia triển lãm đầu tiên của nhóm Ấn tượng tại Paris.
Trong thập niên 1890, Cézanne hoàn thành loạt năm bức tranh về những người lao động chơi bài.

occupation: nhà ngoại giao và chính trị gia

fieldEvidence.rationale: Sự nghiệp ngoại giao, giữ chức Tổng Thư ký Liên Hợp Quốc và điều hành chính phủ Peru thuộc lĩnh vực xã hội, pháp luật và công vụ.

newProfiles.birthplaceEvidencePhrase: nació en Lima el 19 de enero de 1920

after.biography: Javier Pérez de Cuéllar là nhà ngoại giao và chính trị gia Peru. Ông giữ chức Tổng Thư ký Liên Hợp Quốc trong mười năm, sau đó trở lại chính trường Peru và giữ chức thủ tướng giai đoạn 2000–2001.
highlights: Javier Pérez de Cuéllar giữ chức Tổng Thư ký Liên Hợp Quốc trong mười năm.
Năm 2000–2001, ông kiêm nhiệm chức thủ tướng Peru.
